summary: The entry's Forest Service page now 404s and the Lolo NF area lists no longer include Muchwater; recreation.gov still carries the Forest Service's record (facility 10134443, not reservable): confirmed 15 dispersed sites with fire rings, no water, pack-in/pack-out. Directions: I-90 St. Regis exit 33, ~16 mi NE on Hwy 135, or 6 mi SW from Hwy 200 past Quinn's, following signs. Not stated: fees (derived free left), toilets (derived vault left), tables, rig fit, stay limit. Note unchanged.
flags: Dead website: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/muchwater-dispersed-campground-and-recreation-area returns 'Page not found' (as does the old recarea ?recid=83462 link recreation.gov gives). The only surviving agency page is recreation.gov's information listing https://www.recreation.gov/camping/poi/10134443.

Missing phone: the Lolo NF supervisor's office (406) 329-3750 is the only number on the forest's pages; the district is not named on the surviving listing (Superior RD, (406) 822-4233, covers St. Regis).
Dispersed area: the agency designates 15 dispersed sites but says nothing on RV access or site size; the note's 'some pull-offs fit a decent RV' is unsourced.
